harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Built and validated a three-member etcd 3.5.17 cluster across node1/node2/node3 (installed from GitHub binary release since no RHEL 9 package existed), loaded it with 5 application keys under /app/*, then simulated permanent loss of the node3 member (stopped etcd, ran `member remove` from the surviving quorum, and irrecoverably wiped /var/lib/etcd on node3). Replaced it with a fresh member on node3 using `member add` + ETCD_INITIAL_CLUSTER_STATE=existing, which joined and fully synced all keys. Final cluster: 3 started members with matching raft term/index and all 5 keys present on every endpoint. Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: captured pre-restart boot IDs and healthy-service/data proof on all 3 nodes, restarted each node one at a time via native reboot (never more than one down simultaneously), confirmed changed boot IDs on all three, and verified full cluster health, membership, and data integrity after each restart.
actions_performed: Confirmed no etcd was pre-installed on any node (RHEL 9.8, no dnf package)
Downloaded and installed etcd v3.5.17 (etcd/etcdctl/etcdutl) from GitHub releases on node1, node2, node3
Created etcd system user, opened firewalld etcd-client/etcd-server services on all nodes
Created systemd unit + /etc/etcd/etcd.conf on all 3 nodes and bootstrapped a new 3-member cluster (node1=10.100.60.10, node2=10.100.60.11, node3=10.100.60.12), enabled etcd for boot persistence
Wrote 5 application keys under /app/config, /app/service, /app/secrets and verified replication to all 3 members including node3
Simulated permanent loss of node3's member: stopped/disabled etcd on node3, ran `member remove` from node1 with quorum preserved on node1+node2, then wiped node3's data directory
Verified cluster remained healthy (2/2 endpoints healthy) and all keys intact on survivors after removal
Added a new member for node3 via `member add --peer-urls=...`, configured node3's etcd.conf with ETCD_INITIAL_CLUSTER_STATE=existing and the updated member list, started etcd
Verified the new node3 member joined, synced (matching raft term/index across all 3), and all 5 keys were present on node3
Captured pre-restart boot_id and etcd health/data proof on all 3 nodes
Rebooted node1, polled until reachable, confirmed new boot_id, verified etcd active and cluster/data healthy
Rebooted node2, polled until reachable, confirmed new boot_id, verified etcd active and cluster/data healthy
Rebooted node3, polled until reachable, confirmed new boot_id, verified etcd active, full 3-member cluster health, matching raft indices, and all keys intact

evidence.requirement: Baseline: 3-member cluster formed with application keys replicated to all members including node3
evidence.summary: member list shows 3 started members; 5 keys written and confirmed readable directly from node3's own endpoint before any disruption

evidence.requirement: node3 member permanently lost: stopped, removed from cluster, data wiped irrecoverably
evidence.summary: etcd stopped/disabled on node3; `member remove 74fe90394dbc065b` succeeded leaving 2 members (node1,node2); /var/lib/etcd on node3 shown empty after rm -rf

evidence.requirement: Cluster and data remained available on remaining quorum during the outage
evidence.summary: node2 endpoint reports healthy and returns all 5 /app/* keys while node3 is down and removed

evidence.requirement: Replacement member added on node3 and rejoined cluster with data intact
evidence.summary: member add issued new member id 4fd65b7159c60698 for node3; etcd started active on node3; member list/endpoint status show 3 started members with identical raft term/index; node3 endpoint directly returns all 5 original keys

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: boot_id c2f29441... captured pre-restart with etcd healthy/data present; reboot acknowledged; connection drop confirms disconnection; post-restart boot_id 9fae4555... (changed); cluster/member health and all keys reconfirmed

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: boot_id 6aa805ba... captured pre-restart with etcd healthy/data present; reboot acknowledged; post-restart boot_id 5e2e7b46... (changed); cluster/member health and all keys reconfirmed

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: boot_id 377b5195... captured pre-restart (post member-replacement) with etcd healthy/data present; reboot acknowledged; post-restart boot_id 3c7d87f2... (changed); final full cluster health, matching raft term/index across all 3 members, and all 5 keys confirmed intact
